name: What is the step-by-step process of opening up an enclosed kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process of opening up an enclosed kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before demolition begins, the process involves an on-site structural assessment and layout planning. Next, crews establish dust protection before removing dividing walls. If a wall is load-bearing, temporary shoring walls are erected to support the ceiling before the framing is removed and a permanent structural beam is set. Afterward, plumbers and electricians reroute pipes, gas lines, and wiring. Drywall patching, continuous ceiling finishing, cabinet installation, island placement, and flooring integration complete the transformation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves planning, temporary shoring, wall removal, beam installation, utility rerouting, drywall repairs, and installing new cabinetry and flooring.
